# fast-csv-lite

A tiny, fast CSV parser with zero dependencies.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/fast-csv-lite.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/fast-csv-lite)

## Usage

```js
import { parse } from 'fast-csv-lite';
const rows = parse('a,b\n1,2');
```
